item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate Oracle databases to Azure Database for PostgreSQL using Azure Database Migration Service
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service now supports offline migrations from Oracle to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The preview lets you configure source and target connections, choose schemas, start the transfer, and monitor migration status.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate Oracle databases to Azure HorizonDB using Azure Database Migration Service
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service now supports migrating Oracle databases to Azure HorizonDB in public preview. The migration flow covers source and target connection setup, schema selection, data transfer, and progress tracking in one experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate Azure Database for PostgreSQL to Azure HorizonDB with Azure Database Migration Service (DMS)
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service (DMS) now supports migrating existing Azure Database for PostgreSQL workloads to Azure HorizonDB in public preview. The update extends DMS V2 architecture with HorizonDB as a migration target.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate PostgreSQL servers to Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service now supports public preview migrations of supported PostgreSQL workloads to Azure HorizonDB. The migration experience is guided and available in the Azure portal.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate directly from Azure Arc to Azure SQL Database, including Hyperscale
item.description:
Azure Arc database migration now supports Azure SQL Database, including Hyperscale, as a direct migration target in public preview. The guided workflow also handles Azure Database Migration Service and Self-hosted Integration Runtime setup.

  • Source: Azure Updates
